files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.Authoring.BaseCharacterLocomotorAuthoring<TProfile>.BaseCharacterLocomotorBaker<TAuthoring, TStateMachine, TStates, TContext, TInput, TStateData>
files.Summary:
Baker for the CharacterAuthoring. Converts the authoring data into an ECS entity with the following setup:

  1. Creates the character entity with TransformUsageFlags.ManualOverride and manually adds LocalTransform and LocalToWorld built from the authoring Transform. The character is always produced as an unparented root entity — related entities (player, follower/model) link to it via explicit references, not via the ECS transform hierarchy or LinkedEntityGroup.
  2. If a CharacterProfile is provided: – Generates or reuses a BlobAssetReference from the profile asset (and calls DependsOn so changes re-bake automatically) – Adds LocomotionInput to drive character movement from player input or AI Agent – Builds a CapsuleCollider from profile settings (CapsuleGeometry + CollisionFilter) and adds it as a PhysicsCollider blob asset – Registers the character with the physics world (PhysicsWorldIndex) – Adds LocomotionProfileReference (points to the blob asset), LocomotionData (initial velocity, jump count, etc.), LocomotionGravity (gravity multiplier) – Initializes the CharacterLocomotionStateMachine in the Falling state

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.Authoring.BaseCharacterLocomotorAuthoring<TProfile>
files.Summary:
Serves as a base class for authoring character entities with locomotion capabilities. Designed to work with a profile of type TProfile, enabling customization of character movement and behavior through specific profile definitions. Contains shared properties and functionality for setting up entities related to character locomotion, including rendering models and defining state machines through further specialization. The class includes a nested abstract baker class used for converting authoring data into ECS entities with the following configurations:

  1. Associates the authored character with a profile asset (defining locomotion behavior and rules).
  2. Supports optional assignment of a prefab model entity for visual representation.
  3. Facilitates the integration of locomotion state machines, states, and custom contexts specific to the movement profile.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.Hybrid.Systems.EntityGoEditorPreviewSystem

(2) — closed-subscene baked static meshes that have no GameObject proxy until runs at play start. Both paths feed a shared batch dictionary; identical (Mesh, Material, shadow flags, layer) groups are flushed via Graphics.DrawMeshInstanced when the material supports GPU instancing, with a Graphics.DrawMesh fallback otherwise.

files.Summary: Struct for collecting the closest collider cast hits while ignoring a specific entity. Implements the ICollector interface to gather and manage collider cast hit results. Filters out results that do not meet defined criteria such as hits associated with an ignored entity or backface collisions. This is particularly useful in physics-related computations where certain entities need to be excluded, such as in character or object traversal and detection systems.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.Runtime.Physics.ClosestDistanceHitCollectorIgnoreSelf
files.Summary: Struct for collecting the closest distance-based hits while ignoring a specified entity. Implements the ICollector interface to manage distance hit results and filters hits based on custom criteria such as excluding hits involving a specified entity or backface collisions. Useful in scenarios where distance queries need to selectively exclude certain entities or object surfaces, e.g., during character or object navigation systems in physics simulations.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.Runtime.Physics.ClosestRaycastHitCollectorIgnoreSelf
files.Summary: Struct for collecting closest raycast hits while ignoring a specified entity. Implements the ICollector interface to manage raycast hit results and avoids processing hits that do not meet the criteria, such as hits associated with a self entity or backface collisions. Useful in scenarios where certain entities need to be ignored during raycasting computations, such as character locomotion systems in physics-based simulations.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.Falling
files.Summary: Character accelerates along the gravity vector toward and continues falling at that speed. Rotates to face input but applies no horizontal acceleration — air control lives in .

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.GravityBehavior
files.Summary: Reusable passive-gravity behavior: pulls the character's vertical velocity toward along the gravity vector, capped by × BaseLocomotionContext.GravityStrength. Shared by any state that falls passively (Falling, Sliding) so the integration math lives in one place.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.HorizontalLocomotionBehavior
files.Summary: Reusable horizontal-locomotion behavior: rotates the character toward its input direction and computes the horizontal acceleration that brings its velocity to along that direction (or back to zero when there is no input). Shared by the grounded Moving state and the airborne Jumping state so the integration logic lives in one place and air-control feel is decoupled from takeoff speed.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.Idling
files.Summary: Character stands in place not moving.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.JumpBehavior
files.Summary: Reusable jump-arc behavior: owns the full vertical lifecycle of a jump — trigger detection and impulse injection, variable-height ascent (hold vs release), apex hover, and asymmetric descent. Reads tuning from SimpleCharacterProfile.Jumping.Jumps and per-character state from SimpleCharacterStateData.JumpData, both accessed through the context.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.Jumping
files.Summary: Character is airborne after a ground-initiated jump. Horizontal control mirrors the grounded state scaled by ; vertical logic (trigger, variable-height ascent, apex hover, asymmetric descent) is handled by .

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.Moving
files.Summary: Grounded horizontal locomotion. Target speed is selected at integrate time from or based on . Tapping sprint changes the target speed within this state — it does not trigger a state transition.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.ReorientGravityToContactSurface
files.Summary: Opt-in character behaviour for the SimpleCharacter sample: when the Locomotor's LocomotionContact is on one of the layers in , the Locomotor's LocomotionGravity vector is reoriented to point into the contact surface (opposite of contact.Normal), keeping its current magnitude. When the contact is not on any of those layers — including while airborne — gravity reverts to PhysicsStep.Default.Gravity, the same value BaseCharacterLocomotorBaker uses to initialise LocomotionGravity. Enables wall-walking / gravity-pad mechanics.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.ReorientGravityToContactSurfaceSystem
files.Summary: Reorients a Locomotor's so it points into the contact surface whenever the current is on one of the layers tagged by . Preserves the current gravity magnitude. When the contact is not on any tagged layer — including while the character is airborne — gravity is restored to PhysicsStep.Default.Gravity, the same value the character was baked with.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.SimpleCharacterInput
files.Summary: Per-frame input data for the SimpleCharacter locomotion system. Add fields for movement direction, jump requests, etc.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.SimpleCharacterProfile
files.Summary: Locomotion profile for the SimpleCharacter character. Add serializable fields to expose movement tuning parameters (speed, jump force, etc.).

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.SimpleCharacterStateMachine
files.Summary: Anchor struct for the SimpleCharacter locomotion state machine. The source generator uses this to produce all supporting types, systems, and dispatch code.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SimpleCharacter.Runtime.Sliding
files.Summary: Character slides along a steep surface under gravity with no horizontal authority. Reuses tuning since the vertical feel is the same as a free fall.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.SourceGen.StateMachineSourceGenerator
files.Summary: Roslyn incremental source generator that discovers [LocomotionStateMachine], [LocomotionState], and [LocomotionTransition] structs and emits all supporting types: context, enum, interfaces, state machine dispatch, locomotion system, input reader system, and player input manager system.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.Tests.Bot.SimpleCharacterBotAuthoring
files.Summary: Authoring component placed on a brain GameObject under a character prefab. Bakes a marker on the brain entity carrying a reference to the parent character; the post-bake then seeds the character's SimpleCharacterInput with the authored Move/Jump values. The character walks (constant Movement) and jumps once at start (JumpTrigger consumed by the state machine on the first FixedStep) — the minimum behaviour the BehaviourTests subscenes need from a bot, with no runtime system feeding inputs each tick.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.Tests.Bot.SimpleCharacterBotBakingSystem
files.Summary: Baking system that seeds on every character referenced by a brain that received a marker. Runs after all bakers, so it overrides the default-zero input the locomotor baker adds. Cross-entity writes here are allowed because we use the standard ECS API (EntityManager), not the per-baker API.

files.Title: WAYN.Games.MGM.CharacterController.Tests.Bot.SimpleCharacterBotInput
files.Summary: Baking-only marker placed by on the brain entity so a baking system can seed the referenced character entity's SimpleCharacterInput with the bot's authored Move/Jump intent. Removed at the end of baking.
